requirements.requirement: The system must accept raw prescription behavior data conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1 as input to the transformation function.
The system must rank drugs by relevance using the logic defined in design/design_eval_p_rx_drug_mapping.
The system must return a list of top relevant drugs limited to the maximum count specified in the UI data contract.
The system must compute a normalized relevance indicator value suitable for UI display (e.g., low/medium/high or numeric score).
The system must map backend integrity flags into UI-ready states (e.g., clean or flagged) exactly as defined in the UI contract.
The system must preserve the contribution-to-score value from backend data without modification unless explicitly defined by the transformation rules.
The system must output a transformation result object that exactly matches the structure defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must deterministically produce the same output given identical input data.
The system must handle missing optional fields in the input by applying default values defined in the UI contract without throwing runtime errors.
The system must return an empty top drugs list when no valid drug data is present in the input.
The system must assign a fallback relevance indicator of 'unknown' or equivalent when insufficient data exists to compute relevance.
The system must map any unrecognized integrity flag values to a safe default UI state (e.g., flagged).
The system must not mutate the original input data object during transformation.
The system must complete the transformation within acceptable frontend performance bounds (e.g., under 50ms for typical payload size).
The system must log or surface a structured error when the input data violates the expected schema and cannot be transformed.
